Readeck.PORT: HTTP listener and public target port; do not expose SQL.
Readeck.READECK_SECRET_KEY: Stable generated instance key, min 48 characters; retain for tokens and full export/import.
Readeck.READECK_OWNER_USERNAME: Initial private owner username; keep stable to avoid creating an additional administrator.
Readeck.READECK_OWNER_PASSWORD: Generated private initial password, min 16 characters; not reset for existing users.
Readeck.READECK_OWNER_EMAIL: REQUIRED owner mailbox; SMTP is not included, password reset email needs separate setup.
Readeck.READECK_SERVER_BASE_URL: Canonical HTTPS origin for links and secure cookies.
Readeck.READECK_ALLOWED_HOSTS: Comma-separated approved hostnames (no ports); include Railway healthcheck host.
Readeck.READECK_WORKER_NUMBER: Two in-process extraction workers; no separate shared-volume worker.
Readeck.READECK_PUBLIC_SHARE_TTL: Public bearer share-link lifetime in hours; shares are opt-in and are not authentication.
